pediatricPearls: Use pediatric dosing of medications or electrical therapy for a pediatric patient < 37 kg and as defined by HandTevy, hypotension is defined as SBP < 70 + (age in years x 2) mmHg

pl1: If CPSS+, then specifically assess for motor weakness.
If weak, then Visual Disturbance, Aphasia, and Neglect (VAN) Score
Positive CPSS & Glucose > 50 and last known well < 23 hours, then declare Stroke Alert and < 15 minute-on -scene time
Positive CPSS, weakness, +VAN & Glucose > 50 and last known well < 23 hours, then declare LVO Alert and < 15 minute-on -scene time
pl2: Vascular access, 2 nd vascular access if time and patient conditions permit
